take.title_zh: AI 助理的下一場戰爭：信任、隱私與「進得去」
take.title_en: The Next AI Assistant Battle: Trust, Privacy, and Access
take.body_zh:
本期最明顯的訊號，是 AI 競爭焦點從「模型多強」移到「使用者敢不敢交出控制權」。Underdog、Hark 都把隱私當主打賣點，LibreOffice 甚至把「不內建 AI」包裝成功能；另一邊，AI agents 想替人訂票購物，卻被網站的反爬蟲機制擋在門外。

對設計師與 PM 來說，這代表信任設計正在變成核心產品能力：權限要怎麼揭露、agent 的行為要怎麼讓人看得懂、網站要怎麼辨識「代理人」而不是「機器人」。模型層面，Mistral Large 4 持續加壓，但真正決勝的，可能是誰先把信任體驗做對。
take.body_en:
The clearest signal this issue: the AI race is shifting from "whose model is smartest" to "who will users trust with control." Underdog and Hark lead with privacy, and LibreOffice now markets "no AI" as a feature. Meanwhile, AI agents that want to shop and book on our behalf keep hitting anti-bot walls.

For designers and PMs, trust design is becoming a core product capability: how permissions are disclosed, how agent actions stay legible, and how sites tell a delegated agent from a scraper. Mistral Large 4 keeps pressure on the model layer, but the winners may be whoever gets the trust experience right first.

articles.title_zh: Mistral 推出兆級參數模型 Large 4，力拚超車美中對手
articles.title_en: Mistral's New 1T Model Aims to Leapfrog Closed and Open Rivals
articles.summary_zh: 法國 AI 實驗室 Mistral AI 發布 Mistral Large 4，一款約 1T（兆）參數等級的大型 multimodal 模型，目標是同時超越美國的閉源模型與中國的開源對手。這是 Mistral 在 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 於九月密集發表新模型後的正面回應，也讓歐洲在前沿模型競賽中重新有了存在感。對需要資料主權或歐盟合規的企業而言，多了一個具份量的選項。
articles.summary_en: French lab Mistral AI released Mistral Large 4, a roughly one-trillion-parameter multimodal model pitched as leapfrogging both American closed models and Chinese open rivals. It lands after a dense September of frontier launches from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, and gives Europe a credible seat back at the frontier table. For companies that care about data sovereignty or EU compliance, it adds a serious alternative to the US labs.
articles.take_zh: 對設計團隊來說，模型選擇越來越像「供應商策略」而不只是效能比較。多一個強力的歐洲選項，代表產品可以依地區、法規與成本切換模型，介面設計也要預留這種彈性。
articles.take_en: Model choice is becoming vendor strategy, not just a benchmark contest. A strong European option means products can route by region, regulation and cost — and the UX should be built to absorb that flexibility.

articles.title_zh: AI agents 的下一道關卡：讓網站願意放行
articles.title_en: The Next Hurdle for AI Agents: Getting Websites to Let Them In
articles.summary_zh: 個人 AI agents 承諾幫使用者購物、訂機票、訂餐廳，但許多網站刻意封鎖，或用反機器人（anti-bot）防護把 agent 擋下，讓消費者夾在中間。文章整理了這個卡點的現況，並介紹一項新興標準，試圖讓網站能辨識並有條件放行代表真人行事的 agent，而不是一律當成爬蟲。這是 agent 從 demo 走向日常使用前必須解決的基礎建設問題。
articles.summary_en: Personal AI agents promise to shop, book flights and make reservations, but deliberate blocks and anti-bot defenses keep stopping them, leaving consumers stuck in the middle. The piece maps the standoff and covers a new standard meant to let sites recognize — and conditionally admit — agents acting on behalf of real people rather than treating them all as scrapers. It is plumbing that has to be solved before agents become everyday tools.
articles.take_zh: 這是 UX 的新邊界：網站要設計的不只是給人的介面，還有給 agent 的入口與規則。電商、訂位類產品的 PM 應該開始思考「agent 友善」策略，以及失敗時怎麼優雅地把控制權交還給人。
articles.take_en: UX now has a second audience: agents. Commerce and booking PMs should start drafting an agent-access policy — and design graceful handoffs back to humans when an agent gets blocked.

articles.title_zh: Underdog 上線：主打最高隱私的 on-device AI 助理
articles.title_en: Underdog Launches as the Most Private Instinct/Muse Competitor Yet
articles.summary_zh: 由矽谷新秀 Sigil Wen 打造、背後有一票知名投資人支持的 Underdog，是一款在裝置端運行的 AI 個人助理，標榜免費、完全私密，並能處理日常任務，直接挑戰 Instinct、Muse 等主流助理。同一天，AI 實驗室 Hark 也推出主打隱私的個人助理，定位為「來自未來的作業系統」。隱私正快速成為 AI 助理市場的差異化主軸。
articles.summary_en: Underdog, built by Sigil Wen and backed by a Silicon Valley who's who, is an on-device AI assistant that promises to be free, fully private and capable for everyday tasks — a direct shot at Instinct and Muse. The same day, AI lab Hark launched its own privacy-focused assistant, pitched as an operating system from the future. Privacy is quickly becoming the main axis of differentiation in assistants.
articles.take_zh: 當隱私成為賣點，設計就必須讓「私密」被看見：資料留在哪、哪些事在本機完成，都要有清楚的視覺與文案。否則隱私只是行銷口號，使用者感受不到。
articles.take_en: If privacy is the pitch, design has to make it visible — where data lives, what runs on-device. Otherwise it's just a marketing line users can't feel.

articles.title_zh: Anthropic 送新創一年免費 Claude Team 與 1,000 美元額度
articles.title_en: Anthropic Gives Startups a Free Year of Claude Team and $1,000 in Credits
articles.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出新創計畫，提供符合資格的新創公司一年免費 Claude Team 方案，外加 1,000 美元的 API token 額度。官方說法是：AI 的效益多半會透過「建立在模型之上的公司」觸及大眾，而不是單靠模型本身。這是 Anthropic 在模型大戰之外，往開發者生態與團隊協作工具擴張的一步，也讓小團隊能以近乎零成本把 Claude 導入日常工作流。
articles.summary_en: Anthropic launched a startup program offering eligible companies a free year of Claude Team plus $1,000 in API token credits. The company's rationale: AI's benefits will reach most people through companies building on top of models, not the models alone. It's an ecosystem play beyond the model race, and lets small teams fold Claude into daily workflows at near-zero cost.
articles.take_zh: 對小型設計／產品團隊是實際的福利，值得評估把 Claude 用在研究整理、文件與原型上。但也要注意一年後的轉換成本——免費期正是平台鎖定使用習慣的時候。
articles.take_en: A real perk for small design and product teams — worth trialing for research synthesis, docs and prototyping. Just watch the year-two switching cost; free tiers are where habits lock in.

articles.title_zh: 命名實戰指南：從顏色、元件到 design tokens
articles.title_en: A Practical Guide to Naming Things
articles.summary_zh: 命名很難，而我們使用的語言會形塑思考方式與團隊溝通。這篇 Smashing Magazine 文章探討為何顏色、icon、UI 元件、功能、design tokens、HTML class 與變數的命名總是混亂：名稱太籠統會看不懂，太具體又難以重用。文中整理多種命名策略與資源，例如提供主題化詞彙清單的 Classnames，以及顏色命名工具，協助團隊建立一致的命名慣例。
articles.summary_en: Naming is hard, and the words we choose shape both thinking and team conversation. This Smashing piece looks at why naming colors, icons, UI components, features, design tokens, classes and variables gets messy: too generic and nobody knows what's meant, too specific and nothing is reusable. It rounds up strategies and resources — like Classnames' themed word lists and color-naming tools — to help teams settle on consistent conventions.
articles.take_zh: Design system 的品質常敗在命名。當 AI 開始讀取 tokens 與元件來生成介面，一致、語意清楚的命名更直接影響 AI 產出品質，值得團隊重新盤點。
articles.take_en: Design systems often fail at naming. Now that AI tools read your tokens and components to generate UI, clear semantic names directly shape output quality — worth an audit.

articles.title_zh: 傳 Apple 與 LG 合作推出智慧門鎖、溫控器與門鈴
articles.title_en: Apple Reportedly Partnering With LG on a Smart Lock, Thermostat, and Doorbell
articles.summary_zh: 根據報導，Apple 準備以一系列新裝置正式進軍智慧家庭市場，並找來 LG 作為關鍵合作夥伴，產品可能包括智慧門鎖、溫控器與門鈴。過去 Apple 在智慧家庭主要透過 HomeKit 平台串接第三方，若自有品牌硬體成真，將與 Google Nest、Amazon Ring 正面競爭。目前仍屬報導階段，Apple 尚未正式宣布。
articles.summary_en: Apple appears poised to push into the smart home with a slate of new devices — reportedly a smart lock, thermostat and doorbell — with LG as a key partner. Apple has mostly played in the home via the HomeKit platform and third-party devices; first-party hardware would put it head-to-head with Google Nest and Amazon Ring. It's still a report; Apple hasn't announced anything.
articles.take_zh: 智慧家庭的 UX 痛點一直是設定繁瑣與跨品牌整合。Apple 若親自下場，最值得觀察的是它如何把 onboarding 與自動化設計做到「不用想」。
articles.take_en: Smart home UX has always suffered from painful setup and cross-brand mess. If Apple goes first-party, watch how it makes onboarding and automations effortless.

articles.title_zh: LibreOffice：「不內建 AI」現在是一項功能
articles.title_en: LibreOffice Says 'No AI' Is Now a Software Feature
articles.summary_zh: 開源文書軟體 LibreOffice 的開發方表示，目前沒有計畫在預設設定中加入 AI 功能，理由是保護使用者隱私。在幾乎所有生產力工具都急著塞進 AI 助理的此刻，LibreOffice 反其道而行，把「沒有 AI」定位成差異化賣點，回應了一群對資料外流、強制 AI 功能感到反感的使用者。
articles.summary_en: The maker of open-source office suite LibreOffice says it has no plans to add AI to its default configuration, citing user privacy. While nearly every productivity tool races to bolt on an assistant, LibreOffice is positioning "no AI" as a differentiator — speaking to users wary of data leakage and AI features they never asked for.
articles.take_zh: 這是很好的產品提醒：AI 不該是預設強加的功能。讓使用者能選擇開關、清楚知道資料去向，本身就是一種被低估的設計價值。
articles.take_en: A useful product reminder: AI shouldn't be forced on by default. Clear opt-ins and data transparency are an underrated design value in their own right.

articles.title_zh: AI 決策模型可能如何改變內容審核
articles.title_en: How AI Decision Models Could Change Content Moderation
articles.summary_zh: Musubi 於週二發布 PolicyLM-1.7B，這是一款專為即時內容審核設計的輕量決策模型，並以 open weights 形式釋出。相較於用大型通用 LLM 處理審核，小型專用模型更便宜、更快，也讓平台能依自身政策調整與部署。文章探討這類「決策模型」可能如何改變社群與 UGC 平台處理違規內容的方式。
articles.summary_en: On Tuesday, Musubi released PolicyLM-1.7B, a lightweight decision model built for real-time content moderation, with open weights. Compared with routing moderation through large general-purpose LLMs, small specialized models are cheaper and faster, and let platforms tune them to their own policies. The piece explores how such decision models could reshape moderation on social and UGC platforms.
articles.take_zh: 即時審核意味著使用者會更常「當下」被擋。設計重點在於回饋：被判定違規時，介面如何解釋原因、提供申訴，會直接影響社群信任。
articles.take_en: Real-time moderation means users get blocked in the moment more often. The design work is in the feedback — explaining why and offering appeals is what preserves community trust.
